partially_covered.missing: Limited detail on organization attributes; only basic address and identifier, no contact info or additional organizational metadata.
Only item name and net price; missing product codes, descriptions, and units of measure.
No explicit modeling of mandatory fields or D96A directory requirements; SHACLConstraint class present but not detailed.

cq_coverage.details: Most core questions about invoices, roles, organizations, prices, and structure are answered. Some details on organization and item metadata, and explicit data validation requirements, are lacking or only implicit.

strengths: Rich multi-level hierarchy (Envelope > Message > Section > Line)
Good use of restrictions and property characteristics
weaknesses: No general class axioms (GCAs) for advanced semantic definitions
Limited use of domain-specific disjointness (could add more for segments/elements)
No modeling of SHACL constraint details

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range in some object properties (minor risk)
P7: Missing inverse properties for some data properties (minor risk)
reasoner_risks: Hermit/Pellet may struggle with deeply nested restrictions but no datatype issues detected
No use of illegal datatypes; all in OWL2 DL core

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand organization and item information (CQ5, CQ8) with additional properties: contact info, legal form, product codes, units, descriptions.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves coverage and supports richer queries on participants and products.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model mandatory field constraints and D96A directory requirements explicitly, possibly as SHACL shapes or OWL restrictions.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables automated validation and full answer to CQ13.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add general class axioms (GCAs) to define, e.g., 'ValidInvoice' as one fulfilling all mandatory constraints.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Adds semantic depth and supports advanced reasoning.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Increase disjointness axioms among EDIFACT segment/element classes to prevent unintended inferences.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves logical consistency and error detection.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add individuals for common EDIFACT segment codes and element codes for more precise technical modeling.

summary: The ontology provides strong coverage of EDIFACT invoice structure, roles, and core business concepts, with robust use of OWL 2 constructs and good annotation and directionality. Coverage of organization and item details, mandatory validation constraints, and advanced axiomatization can be improved for full semantic and technical completeness.
